description: At night the walled town of Laguardia lies dark on its hill under the stars — the 13th-century walls and five gates catching only faint moonlight, a few warm windows glowing among the honey-coloured streets, the Sierra de Cantabria dark on the horizon and the vineyards of Rioja Alavesa sleeping below. Below the cobbled streets runs the larger town: some three hundred underground wine caves, Emmental-like in the earth. The medieval atmosphere keeps its ancient touch even in the dark.

Quiet, honest night mood. No identifiable people prominent. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere, no on-image text at all.
